page.layout: Full-width area at top: two engraved coin portraits side by side, with legends around their rims. Below them one text column, with two paragraphs and a closing line. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: TVLLVS Hostilius tertius Romanorum Rex, regnauit
anno mundi 3293. ante Christum natum 669.Hic primus Ro-
manorum purpura & fascibus usus est: bella reparauit, fiducia
bene exercitæ iuuentutis: Albanos vicit sexta congressione:
Veientes, Sabinos, & Fidenates itidem. fœdere rupto,de Me-
tio Suffetio supplicium sumit ob violatam fidem. Horatij Cu-
riatios vincūt: Alba solo æquatur:ex Albanis & Romanis unu-
s fit populus. Tradunt volentem Tullum Hostilium commen-
tarios Numæ cùm quædam occulta solennia sacrificia Iouis Eli-
cio facta inuenisset, operatum his sacris se abdidisse: sed non
rite initum id sacrum esse: nec solùm nullam ei oblatam cœle-
stium speciem,sed ira Iouis solicitati praua religione, fulmine
ipsum cum domo conflagrasse. Imperauit annos 32. ciuitatem
auxit,adiecto Cœlio monte.hoc imperante Byzantium ciuitas
condita est à Paufania Rege Spartanorum. Titus Liuius lib.1.
Decad.1.Eutrop.lib.1.Diony.Halicarn.lib.3.
ANCVS Martius Numæ ex filia nepos, successit Tullo
Hostilio anno mundi 3325. ante Christum natum 637. contra
Latinos dimicauit,quos & vicit: Auentinum montem ciuitati
adiecit,& Ianiculum.Pontem Subliciù in Tyberi fecit.Ostiam
ciuitatem supra mare 16.miliario ab urbe Roma,condidit.Prol.
lib.3.cap.1.& Strab.li.5. Huius temporibus Lucumo,cui nomen
fuit L.Tarquinius Priscus,cum uxore Tanaquil Romam venit.
Anno imperij 24. morbo perit Ancus , quo regnante Epidam-
nus est condita, quæ nunc Dyrrachium. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: The two coin engravings at the top carry legends around their rims, partly legible as TVLLVS HOSTIVS (right of left coin) and ANCVS MARTIVS (left of right coin); the rest of the legends is too worn to read and is not transcribed. Stray comma-like mark after "lib.3." at the right of the last line of the first paragraph is a printer's mark or speck, not text.
